name: Become A Rock Star
source:
You play as a young guy who lived in a very rich family, but decided to go his own way to create his own rock band. The path of the rising rock star will not be easy. Ahead of you are waiting for new acquaintances, difficult decisions, life tests and, of course, pretty girls. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/MrJetikkk]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个生活在一个非常富有的家庭的年轻人，但决定走自己的路创建自己的摇滚乐队。冉冉升起的摇滚明星之路并不平坦。在你前面等待着新朋友、艰难的决定、生活考验，当然还有漂亮的女孩。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/MrJetikkk]Patreon[/url]]
